What? The witch? No worries.\nThe castle is guarded only by big hands, and they\ngo out a few times a day.
You came at the right time.\nRight? Jeila?
Yea, couldn't be better.\nWe were planning to visit my mom's mansion.\nCome with us.
...What for, you ask? There are many interesting\nthings there. There should be lots of sweets that\nmy mom made. We can play with her in the basement.
Don't think.\nWe're going, so you are going too!
Right, pom! You must come, pom!!
You heard what we were planning.\nYou're coming with us!
What? ...Oh, you don't have to worry about that.\nShe will welcome you because we know who you are.\nNow, let's go!
